item.rs_integration.resonance_storage_di: All things stored. Every power carried.
No need to hold them; countless relics and charms echo their power through the storage network.
Hold Sneak to view the resonance rules
Stored items count as carried, enabling passive effects and resource lookups.
Durability, data, and state changes are saved back to the disk.
Supports potion charms, mixed potion charms, the Infernal Tear, Quartz Flower, Spectral Eye Amulet, and Totem of Blessing.
Also supports Nine Swords manuals, buff curios, and grouped infinite potions.
Powder Snow, Source, Venom, and Hot Spring buckets can be used in recursive crafting.
To gain Void Favor, throw the disk into the well;
or connect it to the network, carry a terminal, and jump into the well. This also unlocks special transmutations.
Only one Resonance Disk is active in each storage network.

Limits: 8 entries, 2048 characters each, 8192 total, depth 8, 256 visited tags/key scans per compound. Matching fields are prioritized. [truncated] marks incomplete excerpts; these are not importable SNBT. No inventory/network scan, mutation or upload.

rsi.diagnostic.attach_logs:
This task summary does not replace game logs.
Attach this report and logs/latest.log from the same session, plus logs/debug.log when available.
For multiplayer issues, include server-side logs where possible; note when they are unavailable.
Exporting this report does not copy those log files.

rsi.diagnostic.truncated: Report truncated at the size limit.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.materials: Check the missing ingredient and its variant/NBT, available network stock, and extraction permissions.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.busy: Check other tasks using this machine and the concurrency limit. Retry after those tasks finish.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.chunk: Load the machine's dimension/chunk and check that the bound block still exists.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.compatibility: Compare the machine mod and RSI builds on both sides. Keep this report with the server log.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.input: Check the machine's input slots, recipe conditions and protection rules; conflicting items may prevent startup.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.output: Check the output slot and storage space, item-collecting pipes, and whether the actual output matches the recipe. Do not retry blindly before checking produced items.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.timeout: A timeout does not identify the cause. Check power, fluids, special resources, output space and whether the machine is still processing.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.network: Check that the bound storage network is online, accessible and in a loaded chunk.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.binding: Bind a machine that supports this recipe, then check its dimension and current block.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.resource: Check the named resource in the raw detail, such as mana, Source, experience or Wissen.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.stopped: The task stopped with the player or server session. Check the machine and returned items before retrying.
rsi.diagnostic.hint.unknown: No specific cause was confirmed. Keep this report and the server log around the failure; do not assume materials were refunded.
item.rs_integration.rs_void_upgrade.tool: Voids matching items added to the RS network after installation
item.rs_integration.rs_void_upgrade.conf: Right-click while held; Shift-right-click when installed
screen.rs_integration.void_upgrade.jei_d: Drop a JEI item here; on Tags, lists its tags
screen.rs_integration.void_upgrade.jei_c: Some containers must be dragged from JEI, or the void rule may not match and destroy them
rs_integration.unified_grid.container_hi: Click to change resource type. Items: extract to cursor, Shift-click to inventory. Containers: left-click fluid to fill, right-click to empty; left-click blank space to store the item. Empty-handed filling needs a bucket in the network.
